updates.detailed_summary_zh:
Coinbase 现在允许股票股份用作 DeFi 协议中的抵押品，将传统证券融入去中心化金融。

此举连接了传统金融与去中心化金融，可能扩大链上借贷的抵押品基础，并吸引新的用户和流动性进入 DeFi。

该服务基于代币化股票，即现实世界股票的数字表示。公告未详细介绍具体支持的股票、抵押比率或 DeFi 协议。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
Coinbase now allows shares of stocks to be used as collateral in DeFi protocols, integrating traditional securities into decentralized finance.

This move bridges traditional finance and decentralized finance, potentially expanding the collateral base for on-chain lending and attracting new users and liquidity to DeFi.

The service relies on tokenized stocks, which are digital representations of real-world shares. Specific supported stocks, collateral ratios, or DeFi protocols were not detailed in the announcement.
